name: Of the Red Flower
source:
Akino Kurosawa, with the help of the twin exorcists, Natsuhiko Tsukumo and Fuyuhiko Tsukumo, wishes to uncover the mystery of the disappearance of her twin sister, Haruno Kurosawa, during the test of courage. In return, Akino has to help them gather information about the [Phantom Flower], a legendary red flower that is said to be able to grant wishes. However, it seems like her case has something to do with the red flower.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/of-the-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在双胞胎除灵师九十九夏彦与九十九冬彦的协助下，黑泽秋乃希望能查明双胞胎妹妹黑泽春乃在试胆大会期间离奇失踪的真相。作为交换条件，秋乃必须协助兄弟二人收集传说中能够实现愿望的红色花朵——“幻影之花”的情报。然而随着调查深入，妹妹失踪一案似乎与这朵红花有着千丝万缕的关联。

[摘自[url=https://altila.itch.io/of-the-red]itch.io[/url]]
